technicalDecisions: Responsive design for mobile and desktop

title: RANKED - Gamified Social Media Platform
description: RPG-style competitive social media platform with XP, levels, and leaderboards
fullDescription: RANKED transforms social networking into an RPG-style competitive experience where every action counts. Post content, engage with others, and earn XP. Progress through 50 levels from Novice to Legendary, unlock 25+ unique achievement badges, and compete on global leaderboards. Built with enterprise-grade architecture to showcase Spring Batch expertise, SOLID principles, and modern full-stack development practices.
technicalDecisions: Spring Batch for background gamification jobs (XP calculation, level progression, badge assignment)
JWT-based stateless authentication with BCrypt password hashing
MongoDB Atlas for cloud-hosted database with Spring Data MongoDB
React 18 with Vite for modern frontend tooling and fast development
Tailwind CSS for responsive, mobile-first design with dark mode optimization
Role-based access control (USER/ADMIN) with Spring Security
Clean architecture with layer separation following SOLID principles
futureImprovements: Complete Phase 2: Social features (posts, likes, comments, follow system, activity feed)
Complete Phase 3: Full gamification with Spring Batch jobs (streaks, advanced badges)
Add Phase 4: Advanced animations, real-time notifications, performance optimization
